subject.title: Session stats are missing for Codex

question: Should Codex Auto mode recover a missing five-hour lane for Plus-class accounts, and if so may it query another source without reintroducing recurring background `codex app-server` launches?
rationale: Repository history contains two deliberate but competing policies: recover a dropped session lane and avoid costly fallback when partial quota data remains usable.

options.title: Bounded lane reconciliation
options.body: Recover only the missing 300-minute lane from a same-account source without replacing valid weekly data or enabling general background fallback.

options.title: Keep partial-data policy
options.body: Continue showing weekly-only results and add an explicit incomplete-source diagnostic rather than querying another source automatically.

options.title: Restore automatic fallback
options.body: Treat a missing Plus session lane as an error and run the normal alternate source, accepting the previously reported process and token cost.

recommendation.title: Bounded lane reconciliation
recommendation.body: Recover only the missing 300-minute lane from a same-account source without replacing valid weekly data or enabling general background fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the current fallback boundary and is the strongest available owner for choosing its intended exception policy.
